newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold Fields Sept qtr gold output, net drop.
newsitem.headline: Gold Fields Sept qtr gold output, net drop.

text.p: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd said combined net profits before capital expenditure for its three gold mining companies dropped to 274.41 million rand in the quarter to end-September from 355.86 million rand in the preceding quarter.
Capital expenditure was 200.08 million rand in the September quarter versus 231.39 million rand in the three months to September.
Total gold production was 21,172 kg versus 23,021 kg on a milling rate of 2,643,000 versus 2,630,000 tonnes. Yields averaged 8.0 grams per tonne versus 8.4.
The average working cost was 43,097 rand per kg versus 37,370. The average gold price received was 55,164 versus 53,629.
The figures are for Deelkraal Gold Mining Co Ltd, Driefontein Consolidated Ltd and Kloof Gold Mining Co Ltd.
